{{short description|British chemist}}
'''David Michael Hodgson''' is the Todd Fellow and Tutor in Chemistry at [[Oriel College, Oxford|Oriel College]], [[Oxford]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.oriel.ox.ac.uk/content/102/dr-david-hodgson-tutor-in-chemistry|title=Academic Staff|publisher=Oriel College|access-date=2010-04-18|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110412051829/http://www.oriel.ox.ac.uk/content/102/dr-david-hodgson-tutor-in-chemistry|archive-date=2011-04-12|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Hodgson achieved his [[Bachelor's degree|Bachelor of Science]] at the [[University of Bath]] and gained his [[Doctor of Philosophy]] from the [[University of Southampton]]. His research interests are in synthesis, broadly encompassing studies directed towards the design and development of new methods, reagents and strategies for the synthesis of biologically active molecules.
